name: rentemester-vat-filing-evidence-v43
sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vat_filing_evidence_events (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, period_start TEXT NOT NULL, period_end TEXT NOT NULL, field_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(field_name IN ('rubrikBVarerEuSalesList','rubrikBVarerIkkeEuSalesList','rubrikBYdelser','olieOgFlaskegasafgift','elafgift','naturgasOgBygasafgift','kulafgift','co2Afgift','vandafgift')), amount_dkk REAL NOT NULL, evidence_ref TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(evidence_ref)) BETWEEN 1 AND 500), event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_type IN ('recorded','superseded')), supersedes_event_id INTEGER REFERENCES vat_filing_evidence_events(id), actor TEXT NOT NULL, principal TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(period_start,period_end,field_name,event_type,supersedes_event_id)); CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS current_vat_filing_evidence AS SELECT e.* FROM vat_filing_evidence_events e WHERE e.event_type='recorded' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM vat_filing_evidence_events s WHERE s.event_type='superseded' AND s.supersedes_event_id=e.id); CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS vat_filing_evidence_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON vat_filing_evidence_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'VAT filing evidence is append-only'); END; CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS vat_filing_evidence_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON vat_filing_evidence_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'VAT filing evidence is append-only'); END;
